run_multi_hop_qa_demo: run the streamlit demo to answer multi-hop open-domain questions using dense retrieval and an ELECTRA reader
init_retrieval_module: initialize a RoBERTa-based retriever with a FAISS index and document corpus for dense retrieval
init_reader_model: initialize an ELECTRA-large-discriminator QA reader model loaded from a saved checkpoint
encode_and_retrieve_documents: encode a query with the retriever and search the FAISS index for top-k relevant documents
extract_answer_from_chains: pass ranked document chains through the QA reader to extract an answer and supporting passages
